remarks: Enjoy beautiful views of the 3rd hole at Sunset Hills Country Club from this inviting home in Thousand Oaks' desirable East Hills community! Set on a cul-de-sac, this 4 bedroom, 3 bath home offers a versatile layout with a downstairs bedroom and full bath. A formal living room and spacious dining room provide welcoming spaces for gatherings, while the remodeled kitchen features granite countertops, an island with breakfast bar and high-end appliances. Opening to the family room with a cozy fireplace, the kitchen serves as the heart of the home for everyday living and entertaining.
